outlook_causality.title: Inflation climbs to a 3.0% peak in Oct 2026, then eases to 2.0% by Nov 2026
outlook_causality.baseNote: Much of the hump is base effect. The climb to Oct 2026 drops Oct 2025–Oct 2025 out of the comparison, when the gauge rose 0.0%; the fall to Nov 2026 drops Nov 2025–Nov 2025, when it rose 0.0%.

scoreboard_windows.takeaway: Macrogauge has the smallest miss on CPI over the last 1 graded print: 0.500pp mean absolute error, against Cleveland Fed 0.600pp. 1 prints is too few to call a winner.

col_causality.text: Since 2026-08-01, cost of living has jumped from 3.0% to 5.0% while the gauge went from 3.0% to 5.0%. The 30-year mortgage rate is 6.0% (2026-09-30), against 6.0% a year earlier, and the buyer's payment rides the rate; rental-equivalence shelter does not.
